title: Forked
body:
Forked aims to overhaul the trident to be far more reliable, consistent, and intuitive

### Features/Changes
- Tridents have been remodeled and retextured (via a built-in resource pack)
- Loyalty allows Tridents to return prematurely by punching with an empty hand
- Tridents return even without the Loyalty enchantment
- Tridents remember the slot they were thrown from (including the off-hand!)
- Trident melee attacks work like the spear
- Using a Trident no longer slows player movement
- Attacking entities with a Trident melee will restore your breath
- Drowned will drop their tridents far more frequently
- Tridents have increased durability
- Channeling works in both Thunder and Rain
- Players will be considered 'Wet' for 3 seconds after being touched by Rain, Water, Potions, etc.
- Impaling deals increased damage to any entities classified as Wet
- Tridents thrown into the void will return instead of being lost
- Tridents can be repaired with prismarine shards
